messages:
Mina: Quick follow-up from the KV shard postmortem. Need concrete owners for regression detection and remediation tests: prompt regression set, focused load script, and a controlled chaos drill that safely triggers shard eviction behavior.

Josh: +1. Let's treat promptset as an immediate CI guard and load/chaos as the verification lane. Also note pattern: spikes coincide with nightly batch window.

Carla: I9ll take the promptset. Plan to extract 5 seeds from traces (cold-start, batch-aligned spike, streaming short, many-small, long-context). PR by Fri EOD.

Sam: I9ll own the load harness. k6 scenario: ramp 50->1800rps over 10m with an optional TTL-override stage gated by a feature flag. Will include kill-switch. Need the trace snippet for realistic mix. @Josh link?

Josh: Trace: https://redwood.internal/trace/EVT-2026-kv-evict and ticket TICKET-4821 has snapshots and batch-job timing.

Mina: Acceptance criteria: promptset must fail CI if p99 increases >12% or token cost >1.8x vs baseline. Load test pass = p95/p99 within baseline thresholds and token cost <2x.

ops-bot: Created TICKET-5230 "kv-evict: regression set + load + chaos" assigned Carla, Sam due 2026-05-28.

QA-bot: Nightly eval job scheduled: evals/kv-evict runs 03:00 UTC, alerts #eng-platform on failures.

Carla: Will add an "eviction_fingerprint" tag to prompts to make triage easier and include streaming/non-stream variants.

Sam: TTL override example I'll include in the playbook:
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' https://ops-api.internal/shards/7/override-ttl -d '{"ttl_seconds":25}'
Will gate this behind staging rehearsal.

Josh: I'll add monitoring asserts: sustained cache-miss >4% for 3m -> page SRE and add dashboards showing batch alignment.

Mina: Recap owners/timeline: Carla = promptset PR by Fri (TICKET-5231), Sam = load+TTL stage by Tue (TICKET-5232), Josh = monitoring updates by Mon (TICKET-5233). Tabletop next Tue, live drill Wed next sprint. I'll draft post-drill writeup.

Carla: Will ping Product in PR for rollout sign-off.

Mina: Thanks everyone. Keeping thread open until TICKET-5230 moves to In Progress.
